name: Olympus BondFixedExpiryTeller unvalidated bond redemption
summary: BondFixedExpiryTeller.redeem() trusted the caller-supplied bond token's underlying and expiry values without verifying that the token was created by the teller. The attacker supplied a forged bond token, burned its arbitrary balance, and made the teller transfer its real OHM reserves.
notes: The attacker returned the OHM to the Olympus multisig about nine hours later after what Olympus called a negotiated deal, so the anchor is a theft, not a rescue (rule 5), and the return is not subtracted (rule 11).

A forged-token redeem by another party took the remaining 368.17 OHM and sent it to the same multisig without any reported deal; it is treated as an affiliated rescue and kept out of campaign and loss. Earlier redeem calls all redeemed the genuine bond token 0xbb8cbc39.
